title: Copilot on web expands conversation controls
description: Expanded conversation controls for Copilot on the web, providing better management of AI interactions.

title: Copilot code review effort levels are generally available
description: Lite and Balanced effort levels for code review are now generally available, allowing teams to match review depth to PR complexity.

community_feedback.quote: Choose an effort level for each review. When you request a Copilot code review, choose Lite for routine changes or Balanced for larger, more complex changes.

title: Copilot impact dashboard adds a return on investment section
description: New ROI section in the Copilot impact dashboard for enterprises to track value and adoption.

title: MCP allowlists in enterprise managed settings
description: MCP (Model Context Protocol) allowlists now available in enterprise managed settings for better governance.

title: Kimi K3 is now available in GitHub Copilot
description: Kimi K3 model integration added to GitHub Copilot.

title: Queueing Support for Automations
description: Automations now support queueing: set maximum concurrent runs and queue depth per automation, view queue lifecycle states in events table, and monitor activity charts.

community_feedback.quote: Devin delivers genuine ROI for teams running high-volume, well-scoped repetitive engineering tasks

title: Skill and plugin security scanning (beta)
description: Enterprise plans can now enable skill and plugin security scanning to automatically check third-party skills and plugins for malicious content when uploaded or edited.
